XRP Ledger AMM is a native automated market maker built into the XRP Ledger rather than deployed as a smart contract. XRP Ledger AMM uses a constant product pricing formula for its two-asset liquidity pools. XRP Ledger AMM issues liquidity provider tokens to users who deposit assets into its pools. XRP Ledger AMM charges a trading fee set for each pool.

DODO uses a proactive market maker algorithm that sets prices with reference to external price oracles. DODO combines liquidity pools with order-book-style trading. DODO operates on public blockchains such as Ethereum and BNB Chain.

PancakeSwap is a decentralized exchange operating on the BNB Chain. PancakeSwap uses automated market maker liquidity pools based on a constant product formula. PancakeSwap uses its CAKE token for governance and rewards.
